context:
Goal: the ruling-challenge fixes land without carrying a broken branch.
Problem (goal): #2999 had drifted from main; the coordinator took a fresh branch so the fix could merge.
Based on (notes): coordinator pick 09:54 CST Nov 13; owner 10:56 CST put #2963 and #3143 on the express lane.
Departs from: main — adds branch challenge-followups-3 with a clean main merge, as PR #3143; #2999 closed as superseded.

options.gain: The fix reaches main without the old branch's conflicts.
options.how: Branch challenge-followups-3 carries the work plus a clean merge of main; #2999 is closed as superseded.
options.label: New branch and PR #3143 (coordinator's pick)
options.lose: The review history on #2999 stays on the closed PR.

options.gain: One PR keeps the whole history.
options.how: Merge main into #2999 and keep that PR.
options.label: Repair #2999 in place
options.lose: The conflicts must be fixed on the old branch, which is slower.

title: Replace #2999 with a fresh branch and PR (#3143)?
